title: More complete recovery copies before upgrades
changes: Include exact installation records that can sit outside normal recovery folders.
Keep old release files unchanged while using a separately checked upgrade helper.
Preserve saved work and existing conversion and review permissions during upgrades.
limitations: Experimental preview with bounded Forms-to-native-APEX conversion coverage.
APEX generated, technical checks passed and business acceptance remain separate.
Release notes describe software changes, not proof of a successful conversion.
